d:
Long, flowing hair in a bright coral shade with a side-swept fringe. Large, expressive eyes in a vivid orange shade. Apparent age of a young teenager with a cheerful expression. Slender, petite build. A white and blue sailor-style school uniform with a short pleated skirt and a red necktie. Small, pointed white animal ears atop the head and a long, slender white tail.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
